name: Karen Horney
shortBio: German-American psychoanalyst who founded feminist psychology, dismantled Freudian biological determinism ('penis envy'), and theorized basic anxiety, neurotic needs, and cultural origins of psychic conflict.
centralQuestion: How do early interpersonal insecurities and cultural hierarchies—rather than innate biological drives—generate basic anxiety and neurotic self-alienation?

keyWorks.title: The Neurotic Personality of Our Time
keyWorks.description: Reorients psychoanalysis toward cultural and interpersonal sources of anxiety, competitiveness, and alienation.

keyWorks.title: Neurosis and Human Growth
keyWorks.description: Articulates the clash between the 'real self' and the 'tyranny of the should' alongside the three neurotic trends (moving toward, against, or away from people).
